name: volvoxai
description: A C-first inference and training runtime with one generated protobuf API

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node tools/build_web.mjs normal
scripts.build:min: npm run typecheck && node tools/build_web.mjs min
scripts.build:all: npm run typecheck && node tools/build_web.mjs all
scripts.typecheck: python3 tools/generate_api_contract.py --check && python3 tools/check_api_conformance.py --check && python3 tools/generate_wasm_math.py --check && python3 tools/generate_tokenizer_unicode.py --check && python3 tools/generate_proto_enums.py --check && python3 tools/generate_operator_vocabulary.py --check && python3 tools/generate_operator_param_registry.py --check && python3 tools/generate_kernel_registry.py --check && python3 tools/generate_wasm_simd_probe.py --check && node tools/generate_wasm_internal_abi.mjs --check && node tools/generate_shader_catalog.mjs --check && node tools/generate_webgpu_dispatch.mjs --check && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.test:proto-api: node --import tsx --test tests/call_runtime_api.test.mjs tests/bundled_proto_api.test.mjs tests/buffer_contract_wasm.test.mjs tests/proto_large_payload.test.mjs tests/agent_api_contract.test.mjs tests/inference_wasm_host.test.mjs tests/model_control_wasm_dispatch.test.mjs tests/proto_api_engine_host.test.mjs tests/runtime_provider_initialization.test.mjs tests/wasm_public_api.test.mjs tests/gpu_bridge_contract.test.mjs tests/gpu_bridge_execution.test.mjs tests/webgpu_profiling.test.mjs tests/full_host_gpu_lifecycle.test.mjs tests/tokenizer_api.test.mjs tests/profiling.test.mjs tests/authoring_api.test.mjs tests/lora_api.test.mjs
